regime: END-TO-END: rendered free text -> Agent 1 (Ollama) -> FAISS -> conformal gate -> tier; leave-profiles-out folds, same labelling logic as evaluate_oos.py

canonical.text_source: canonical: de-underscored dataset tokens in a fixed template -- a CEILING / wiring check, recall ~1.0 by construction
canonical.comparison_rule: compare end_to_end against oracle WITHIN a mode; do not compare absolute rates ACROSS modes

lay.text_source: lay: every symptom replaced by a real caregiver phrasing from the pre-existing labelled fixture tests/fixtures/symptom_calibration.py (English / Hindi / Hinglish, rotated so messages are code-mixed); profiles lacking a phrasing for any token are SKIPPED, not back-filled with the canonical token
lay.comparison_rule: compare end_to_end against oracle WITHIN a mode; do not compare absolute rates ACROSS modes
